summary: 31-year-old man from Albuquerque, reported missing after his car was found abandoned on Lake Como Road 2.5 mi from the Highway 150 turnoff; neighbors last saw him Feb 11. 17 AVSAR personnel searched the Blanca Massif area; he had called his girlfriend the prior evening to say he was behind schedule but OK, and walked out to his vehicle the next afternoon, healthy, after summiting Mt. Blanca.
responding_agency: Alamosa County Sheriff's Office / Alamosa Volunteer SAR
notes: AVSAR 2010 archive narrative; full search deployment, subject healthy
